exposure: single incision midurethral sling procedure by the Dynamic Intraoperative Standing Sling Technique (DISST)
outcome: subjective success for stress urinary incontinence (cure)
cure rate for intrinsic sphincter deficiency
cohort: The study participants were 139 subjects who underwent the single incision midurethral sling procedure using the Dynamic Intraoperative Standing Sling Technique (DISST) and were considered intraoperative successes.
finding: Subjective outcomes after the successful intraoperative Dynamic Intraoperative Standing Sling Technique (DISST) for stress urinary incontinence remain excellent at 2 years, with a 94% success rate and low complication rates.
